research_question: For a dimensionless finite-core periodic ring, does the resolved |m|=2 growth/oscillation boundary (A) disappear under mesh refinement, (B) converge to a finite dimensionless spectral ratio, or (C) extend into a reproducible coupled multimode and topology-dependent hierarchy?
objective: Adversarially evaluate three nonexclusive nested levels: A no qualified spectral transition in the declared ring model; B a converged sector-specific finite critical ratio; C multiple dynamically qualified, independently supported coupled/topology scales. Strictly separate a spectral boundary from preferred spacing or Euler equilibrium.
null_hypothesis: No qualifying dimensionless spectral scale exists at the declared C4 sector and numerical tolerances; observed crossings may result from discretization, regularization, image truncation or non-equilibrium linearization.
alternative_hypothesis: The physically identified m=2 mode exhibits a stable real-to-imaginary transition at the same finite q across high-N, image-shell and finite-difference ladders; stronger C requires independent coupled evolution and multiple scales.
assumptions: Incompressible regularized finite-core Biot-Savart filament model, not a proved smooth Euler solution.
The cubic periodic lattice has C4 rather than continuous SO(2) rotational symmetry.
Dimensionless a=1, circulation Gamma=1, R/a=4; no SI, SST target or fitted particle constants.
PKLSA E010 v0.4.0 geometry, if supplied, is source-qualified but has no implied dynamic stability.
The predeclared q interval is motivated by earlier blind internally observed transitions; this is a confirmatory numerical scope, not an independent discovery sample.

equations.latex: \mathbf v(\mathbf x)=\frac{\Gamma}{4\pi}\sum_j\frac{\Delta\mathbf l_j\times(\mathbf x-\mathbf m_j)}{(\|\mathbf x-\mathbf m_j\|^2+a^2)^{3/2}}

equations.dimensional_check: all numerical rates scaled by Gamma/a^2

observables.definition: resolved real/imaginary m=2 eigenpair across q and N
critical separation ratio with its discrete search bracket
image-shell, core-kernel, and finite-difference robustness and independent C4 leakage
PKLSA original geometry rigid-motion residual and optional equal-final-time temporal diagnostic

steps.operation: Validate pinned ring source and, when provided, E010/adapter raw hashes without target matching
Scan Fourier C4 blocks and canonical eigenpairs with resolved growth floor; retain raw cases and q brackets
Converge N=64/96/128/160/192, image-shell 2/3, three h values, and core-model diagnostics separately
Check possible physical time evolution and preference of spacing; unresolved until explicitly implemented
Load and audit original E010 component arrays; compute rigid-motion residual and optional equal-final-time numerical trajectory diagnostic
Compare two independent E010 provider source groups and detect dynamically confirmed multiple length scales; unresolved without full tests
Actually execute Python and compiled C++ or GPU static ring sub-kernel on shared hashed inputs and record numerical parity

falsification_criteria.criterion: Reject a proposed m=2 continuum scale if the same physical mode fails high-N location tolerances (N160-N192 <=0.005) after successful quality gates; unresolved if required data absent
B_SPECTRAL_ONLY requires a real-to-imaginary physical m=2 transition with image-shell, FD and high-N gates, full-field dynamical selection still UNRESOLVED
C requires at least two distinct converged length scales with demonstrated coupling, two provenance-independent source groups and both spatial/temporal dynamic convergence; no automatic promotion

edge_cases: A nonpromotion is not evidence for hypothesis A without an exhaustive converged negative search
Sub-floor sign flips and conjugate partners are not independent candidates
Multiple finite-sector roots alone do not establish hierarchy or nonlinear scale attraction
Same analytic PKLSA source group never counts as two providers
Full-field spectral abscissa positive forbids blanket stability claim
One additional graphics processor does not count as a third scientific backend category
predictions: A/B fate discriminated by monotonic same-m high-N roots under fixed criteria
C must exhibit additional independently qualified scales rather than generic Fourier frequencies
No physical SI scale is inferred from dimensionless units
